_notes.ING: id: [name, category, pack, rule (key in RULES)]; prices live in prices.json
_notes.RECIPES: ing amounts are packs per standard serving; batch:true = reheats well; macros are estimates per standard portion
_notes.ATTR: what each ingredient is, for eating-style filters
_notes.STORES: carries: the aisles (ING categories) a store stocks; omit it for a full grocery store
_notes.COOK: how much one pack is in cooking units: [amount, unit]
_notes.CONV: extra units per pack, so recipes can be written in kitchen units; approximate (1 medium onion is about 1 cup diced). Volume (tsp, tbsp, cup) and weight (oz, lb) convert within their family
_notes.FLAGS: cautions shown wherever an ingredient appears; ING_FLAGS lists them per ingredient. Flagged items can be tracked, priced and bought, and always show their flag. cls is the chip style (default r-flag, amber); r-alert (red) is for Dirty Dozen items bought conventional
_notes.items: recipes with items are written as cooked: qty and unit for the whole recipe, which makes serves standard portions. pantry:true items are assumed on hand and never priced. sample:true = placeholder recipe from the prototype

dd.label: Organic · Dirty Dozen
dd.why: On EWG's Dirty Dozen: among the highest pesticide residues in USDA testing, so buy organic.

c15.label: Conventional OK · Clean 15
c15.why: On EWG's Clean 15: little residue detected. Conventional is fine, so we price it that way.

org.label: Organic preferred
org.why: Not on either EWG list, so we default to organic.

wild.label: Wild-caught
wild.why: Wild-caught: no farm antibiotics or feed additives, usually more omega-3.

past.label: Pasture-raised
past.why: Pasture-raised or organic: outdoor access, no routine antibiotics.

grass.label: Grass-fed & finished
grass.why: Grass-fed and finished: no feedlot, better fat profile.

dairy.label: Organic grass-fed dairy
dairy.why: Organic, grass-fed dairy: no added hormones, pasture access.

pantry.label: Organic pantry
pantry.why: Organic staple: a small premium and it keeps.

conv.label: Conventional
conv.why: Doesn't meet our sourcing rules. Allowed, but we'd rather buy organic or grass-fed when we can.

sausage: Ground pork sausage, pasture-raised, no sugar or fillers
pepperoncini: Pepperoncini, no yellow 5 or added sulfites

processed.label: Processed meat · in moderation
processed.why: The WHO's cancer agency (IARC) classes processed meat as a cause of colorectal cancer, so keep it occasional.

moderation.label: In moderation
moderation.why: Not organic or grass-fed. Fine now and then; we wouldn't plan around it.

not-grassfed.label: Not grass-fed
not-grassfed.why: USDA Choice is a quality grade, not a sourcing claim. Buy grass-fed when you can.

dd-not-organic.label: Not organic · Dirty Dozen
dd-not-organic.why: High pesticide residue in USDA testing, and this one is conventional. Buy organic when you can.

not-organic.label: Not organic
not-organic.why: Our default is organic, but this is the conventional one.

check-label.label: Check the label
check-label.why: Jarred: look for a short ingredient list with no added sugar, gums or preservatives.
